stories.title: Trump Says He Wants to 'Clean Out' Gaza, Send Refugees to Egypt and Jordan
stories.summary: President Trump has proposed moving Palestinians from heavily bombed Gaza to Egypt and Jordan, either temporarily or for the long term. He described the enclave as a ‘demolition site’, while Arab countries have rejected such relocation since the war began.

links.headline: Trump Says He Wants to 'Clean Out' Gaza, Send Refugees to Egypt and Jordan
links.excerpt: The president, calling the heavily bombed enclave “a demolition site,” proposed relocating Palestinians temporarily or long-term, a move rejected by Arab countries since the war began.
links.imageAlt: Trump Says He Wants to 'Clean Out' Gaza, Send Refugees to Egypt and Jordan

stories.title: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
stories.summary: Kim Jong Un is promoting a ‘shock brigade’ of 300,000 teenagers and young adults drafted into flood-reconstruction work. The effort is presented as part of his push to control North Korean youth and block the influence of Hollywood and K-pop.

links.headline: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
links.excerpt: The dictator, eager to shut out the influence of Hollywood and K-pop, has been exalting a “shock brigade” of 300,000 teens and 20-somethings drafted into flood reconstruction.
